en.p: For two positive numbers $p$, $q$ and the function $f(x)=x^3-3x^2-9x-12$, when a function $g(x)$ continuous on the set of all real numbers satisfies the following conditions, what is the value of $p+q$? [4 points]

box: (B) The number of real numbers $a$ at which the function $g(x)$ is not differentiable at $x=a$ is 1.
